item.name: Dark mode toggle
item.description:
## Background

Users working at night have asked for a dark theme.

## Goal

The settings page has a **Dark mode** toggle that follows the operating system's colour scheme until the user picks one.
acceptanceCriteria: With no saved choice, the page matches the operating system's colour scheme
Toggling **Dark mode** switches the theme without a reload

phases.name: Toggle on the settings page
tasks: Add a `useColourScheme` hook that reads the saved scheme
Add a **Dark mode** checkbox next to the theme picker

phases.name: Follow the system scheme
tasks: Fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` when no choice is saved
Update the scheme when the operating system's changes
manualChecks: Switch the operating system to dark mode and confirm the page follows

phaseSummaries: Added useColourScheme and a Dark mode checkbox beside the theme picker; the theme switches without a reload.

**Expected:** the test passes.

**Actual:** `formatDate` returns the previous day.
